title: More community projects to explore
summary:
A day of tending the garden: more community apps to find, better creator credits, and fixes for audio access and image backends.

The app catalog added Overtli Studio Suite’s ComfyUI nodes, StyleOps’ brand-asset generator, The Institute of Everything’s fictional museum exhibits, and four existing apps spanning art, fiction, chat, and virtual characters. Polli-com and a Seedance-powered video generator were also restored to the catalog.

Audio generation routes now apply the access checks used by other generation routes, including model permissions, API key budgets, and whether the available Pollen covers the estimated request.

Unavailable app listings were removed, while catalog and README credits were corrected for NetSim, J.A.R.V.I.S., UltimaX Intelligence, PollGen, and several featured apps. Finding a working app is useful; crediting its maker is also a good idea.
